storyCards.headline: Little Liar: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Joan Jett's "Little Liar" reached #19 on the Billboard Hot 100. Joan Jett and the Blackhearts is an American rock band formed in Los Angeles, California in 1979 as a conjunction of lead musician, singer and songwriter Joan Jett and the backup band.

The song peaked at #19 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Little Liar was released in 1988.
